commands.summarize.description: Summarizes a file with the local model, without a model turn.
commands.commit.description: Proposes a commit message for the staged changes (does not commit).
commands.commit.header: Message proposed by the local model (nothing was committed):
commands.commit.no_changes: Nothing is staged: run `git add` first.
commands.commit.no_process: `/local-commit` needs `process.run`, which is not available on this surface or is blocked by policy.
commands.lint.description: Summarizes lint or test output from a file or a command (30 s limit).
commands.lint.file_only: `process.run` is not available here or is blocked by policy: `/local-lint` only accepts an existing file, and "{arg}" is not one.
commands.lint.bad_quotes: The command has an unclosed quote.
commands.error.mcp_down: The `local-delegate` MCP is not responding: check that the daemon is running with `local-delegate doctor`. Details: {detail}
read.ask.question: `{path}` is {kb} KB. Summarize it with the local model, or read it whole?
read.summary.header: Summary of `{path}` made by the local model of `local-delegate` (not the literal content). To modify the file, read with `offset`/`limit` only the part you are going to change: one literal read is enough to edit it. If what this session has read of the file reaches 80 % of its lines, it counts as reading it whole and is summarized too.
read.summary.header_budget: Summary of `{path}` made by the local model of `local-delegate` (not the literal content). To modify the file, read with `offset`/`limit` only the part you are going to change: one literal read is enough to edit it. In this session you can read up to {lines} of its {total} lines literally in all; from 80 % on, it counts as reading it whole and is summarized too.
read.summary.header_ranges: Summary of `{path}` made by the local model of `local-delegate` (not the literal content). Not because of the range's size: with it, what this session has read of the file would reach {pct} % of its {total} lines, and from 80 % on that counts as reading it whole. You have read {read} lines literally; {left} are left (the most is {lines}). To modify it, read with `offset`/`limit` only the part you are going to change.
read.guard.refused: `{path}` has only been read as a summary: before modifying it, read with `offset`/`limit` only the part you are going to change (one literal read is enough; if what was read of the file reaches 80 % of its lines, it is summarized too).
read.warn.large: This read of `{path}` ({kb} KB) may put a lot of text in the context. If a summary is enough, use `local_summarize` with `path`.
status.name: local-delegate
